othermeta.content: Detailed, stepwise procedure to verify tapeless backups: manual trigger, log checks, checksum validation, mount and restore-testing, and escalation steps.
othermeta.name: shortdesc

othermeta.content: Backup log;Checksum;Systemd;Cron;Restore test;Runbook
othermeta.name: entities

othermeta.content: Operational steps for verifying and fixing tapeless-backup failures
othermeta.name: usecase

ol.li: Log onto the MCS Windows Server as Administrator.

Verify the most recent files were written last Saturday. Each backup has a set of three files.
MCS, andlt;system, andgt;_Full_, andlt;date and time, andgt;.zip – Full backup of the Windows server.
MCS, andlt;system, andgt;_SQL_, andlt;date and time, andgt;.zip – Backup of the SQL database.
MCS, andlt;system, andgt;_VMS_, andlt;date and time, andgt;.zip – Full backup of the VMS server.
